title: Signature Spec Anvil
description: Higgins' spec anvil is where vague wishes are hammered into precise specifications: heat, hammer, quench — the spec that survives is hard enough to generate from. Soft specs bounce off.

demo.code:
import random, importlib.util, sys, os
random.seed(1001)
mod="ledger1"
# Genesis: generate a ledger module from a spec dict, import it, run its tests.
spec=dict(name=mod, funcs=["deposit","withdraw","balance"])
code=[]
code.append("BAL=0")
code.append("def deposit(a):\n global BAL\n BAL+=a\n return BAL")
code.append("def withdraw(a):\n global BAL\n assert a<=BAL,'overdraft'\n BAL-=a\n return BAL")
code.append("def balance():\n return BAL")
code.append("def _tests():\n deposit(100); withdraw(30)\n assert balance()==70\n try:\n  withdraw(999)\n  raise SystemExit('no-overdraft-check')\n except AssertionError:\n  pass\n return 'ALL TESTS PASS'")
src="\n".join(code)
path=mod+".py"
open(path,"w").write(src+"\nif __name__=='__main__': print(_tests())\n")
spec2=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(mod,path)
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec2); spec2.loader.exec_module(m)
print(f"generated module: ledger1 funcs={spec['funcs']}")
print("genesis self-test:", m._tests())
os.remove(path)
print("DEMO_OK")
demo.output:
generated module: ledger1 funcs=['deposit', 'withdraw', 'balance']
genesis self-test: ALL TESTS PASS
DEMO_OK
